background: TSB Bank is a UK retail and small-business bank, funded by retail deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages, which passed from Spain's Sabadell to Santander UK.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the bank, at A+, after a three-notch upgrade on 14 May 2026. Against UK mid-sized banks, CET1 of 16.8% and LCR of 189% are above the peer median and NSFR of 152% in the top quarter, but leverage of 5.6% is in the bottom quarter, the figure to watch. Since 31 Dec 2022 leverage has risen 1.4 points, with CET1 and LCR broadly flat, in figures to 30 Jun 2026.
